comment: M4 hub stand-in for the town. M5 replaces this with data/town/locations.json and walkable zones.

activities.label: Eat breakfast with your guardian
activities.say: Your guardian is already halfway out the door. Toast is a form of love.

activities.label: Hang around the cafeteria
activities.say: You sit near the center table. Not AT it. Near it.

activities.label: Run the track
activities.say: Coach Byrne watches you from the bleachers and says nothing. Encouraging.

activities.label: Breakfast special ($4)
activities.say: "You want the good stuff or the MENU stuff?" Gary gives you the good stuff.

activities.label: Work a shift
activities.say: You slice, you wrap, you learn exactly nothing about the recipe.

activities.label: Work the bellows
activities.say: "Took you long enough." The forge breathes when you do.

activities.label: Study old town records
activities.say: Ms. Marlowe sets a book in front of you without being asked. It's the right one.

activities.label: Use the study carrel workbench (craft, 2 AP)
Volunteer shift with Nurse Patti
activities.say: "Oh, you're the new one. I already heard about you."

activities.label: Sit very still and listen
activities.say: Someone is narrating your every step. Out loud. You decide to find this normal.
